records.title: Guinea certified seed distribution campaign 2026
records.description: Guinea's Ministry of Agriculture reports the official launch of the 2026 certified-seed distribution campaign and current agricultural input initiatives.

records.title: Guinea agricultural equipment access — Ministry of Agriculture
records.description: Official Ministry of Agriculture information includes access to agricultural equipment through IPAM and current equipment-related support.

records.title: Guinea Agricultural Development Fund (FODA)
records.description: Public agricultural development fund providing financial and non-financial support to agricultural promoters, including mechanisms for finance, equipment, irrigation, storage, processing and renewable energy investments.

records.title: Guinea FODA agricultural equipment request portal
records.description: Official application portal for agricultural equipment needs, including tractors, harvesters and implements for agricultural enterprises and producer organisations.

records.title: Guinea Institute of Agronomic Research (IRAG)
records.description: Public agricultural research institute providing agronomic advice, improved seed production, technical training, research programmes and farmer-oriented technical resources.
records.source: Institut de Recherche Agronomique de Guinée (IRAG)
